section.heading: Tea with the Queen example
section.body:
• 200g–300g pasta

  • 100g cream cheese

  • 2 courgettes, chopped

  • 2 cobs of sweetcorn (or 1 tin)

  • 1 bell pepper, diced

  • 100g runner beans, sliced diagonally

  • 1 onion, sliced

  • 2 cloves of garlic, minced

  • 1 tbsp oil or butter, salt, and pepper

    1. Boil the pasta in salted water, throwing in the sliced runner beans for the last 3 minutes of cooking. Drain, making sure to scoop out and save a cup of the pasta water.

    2. Heat the oil in your pan over medium-high heat. Fry the onion, garlic, and pepper for 3 minutes.

    3. Add the courgettes and sweetcorn to the pan and fry for another 5 to 7 minutes until everything is tender.

    4. Turn the heat down to low. Add the cream cheese and a generous splash (about 60ml) of the saved pasta water directly into the hot vegetable pan. Stir gently until it melts into a smooth, creamy sauce.

    5. Toss the drained pasta and runner beans into the sauce. Mix well until everything is evenly coated, adding another splash of pasta water if it looks too thick. Season with plenty of salt and black pepper.
